description: Required minimum distribution — IRS required minimum distribution for a traditional IRA, 401(k), 403(b) or 457 (offline): SECURE 2.0 start age by birth year (72/73/75), first-RMD-year April 1 deadline and the double-RMD trade-off, IRS Uniform Lifetime Table divisor, RMD amount and monthly equivalent, the 25%/10% shortfall excise tax, optional multi-year projection (years=1-30, growth=% per year, default 5). Inputs: balance (December 31 prior-year value) plus birth_year or age; optional year, account=ira|401k|403b|457|roth_ira|roth_401k (Roth owners have no RMD), spouse_age (flags when the Joint Life table would apply). Inherited accounts not covered. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
